name: Site Audit (review a website + propose ranked improvements)
description: Inspect a live website across dimensions (message/hierarchy, brand, responsive, accessibility, performance, SEO/social preview, links, content, UX) and produce a RANKED improvement proposal with a staging preview of the top idea — propose, never auto-apply.
author: architect-prime
when_to_use: When asked to review or improve a website, or when an open-ended site request invites more than the literal ask — to find, rank, and PROPOSE concrete improvements (not apply them), prototyping the strongest idea on a staging preview channel. Not for a narrow literal edit.
